reason: Integrates the Xiaomi MiMo API into DSH agents, primarily providing external model, web-search, multimodal media, speech, and voice tools.

summaries.zh: 将小米 MiMo API 集成到 DSH 智能体中，提供网页搜索、图像与音视频理解、语音识别、语音合成和声音克隆工具。
summaries.en: Integrates the Xiaomi MiMo API into DSH agents with tools for web search, image and audio-video understanding, speech recognition, speech synthesis, and voice cloning.

capabilities: Calls the Xiaomi MiMo API for model responses and web search
Reads local image, audio, and video files for multimodal requests
Performs speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice cloning
Writes generated audio files and uses temporary request and response files
Uses Python and DSH shell or sandbox services for API request execution
